uses.quote: This is where a third party (including a person or AI) completes work on your behalf which you then submit as your own unaided work.
Unacknowledged quotation of phrases from another’s work or unreferenced work generated by AI.
The deliberate and detailed presentation of another’s concept as your own. This includes unauthorised AI-generated concepts.
Verbatim copying or insertion of another’s work without appropriate acknowledgement. This includes published or unpublished work and material freely available in electronic form or generated by AI.
The fabrication of references or a bibliography.

decided_by.quote: The University has outlined what it considers to be acceptable and unacceptable use of AI. This is detailed in the AI Toolkit for Students which is published on the Virtual Learning Environment.

consequence.quote: Unacknowledged quotation of phrases from another’s work or unreferenced work generated by AI.
